description: Independent replication: is the bll6421-bll6428 operon induced by a pterocarpan flavonoid in GSE26380?
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
url="https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE26nnn/GSE26380/matrix/GSE26380_series_matrix.txt.gz"
open("/tmp/g.gz","wb").write(requests.get(url,timeout=60).content)
df=pd.read_csv("/tmp/g.gz",compression="gzip",sep="\t",comment="!",low_memory=False).set_index("ID_REF")
dmso=["GSM647630","GSM647632","GSM647634"]; p6=["GSM647631","GSM647633","GSM647635"]
d=df[p6].values - df[dmso].values          # paired, per array
fc=pd.Series(np.nanmean(d,axis=1),index=df.index)
t,p=stats.ttest_rel(df[p6].values,df[dmso].values,axis=1,nan_policy="omit")
res=pd.DataFrame({"log2FC":fc,"p":np.asarray(p,dtype=float)}).dropna(subset=["log2FC"])
# genome order from locus tag number
num=res.index.to_series().str.extract(r"^bl[lr](\d+)")[0]
res=res[num.notna()].copy(); res["ord"]=num.dropna().astype(int).values
res=res.sort_values("ord")
OP=[f"bll{n}" for n in range(6421,6429)]
op=res.reindex(OP).dropna(subset=["log2FC"])
print("GSE26380 (pterocarpan P6 20 uM, 24 h, USDA110), n=3 paired arrays")
print(op[["log2FC","p"]].round(3).to_string())
obs=op["log2FC"].mean(); k=len(op)
print("\noperon mean log2FC = %.3f over %d probes"%(obs,k))
# sliding contiguous-window genomic null
v=res["log2FC"].values; W=np.array([v[i:i+k].mean() for i in range(len(v)-k+1)])
emp=(np.sum(W>=obs)+1)/(len(W)+1)
print("genome mean %.3f sd %.3f ; sliding-window empirical P(one-sided) = %.4f ; percentile %.1f"%(
      v.mean(),v.std(),emp,stats.percentileofscore(W,obs)))
u,pu=stats.mannwhitneyu(op["log2FC"],res.loc[~res.index.isin(OP),"log2FC"],alternative="greater")
print("Mann-Whitney operon vs rest: U=%.0f p=%.3g"%(u,pu))
for g in ["bll6422","blr6429","bll6430","bll6420","bll6431"]:
    if g in res.index: print(" %s log2FC=%+.3f p=%.3f"%(g,res.loc[g,"log2FC"],res.loc[g,"p"]))
nod=[g for g in ["bll2049","bll2050","bll2051","bll2052","blr2027","bll2039"] if g in res.index]
print(" nod-region probes:", {g: round(res.loc[g,"log2FC"],2) for g in nod})
# figure
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4))
ax[0].hist(W,bins=80,color="#b9c4d2"); ax[0].axvline(obs,color="#c1442e",lw=2)
ax[0].set_xlabel("mean log2FC of a contiguous 8-gene window"); ax[0].set_ylabel("windows")
ax[0].set_title("GSE26380 pterocarpan P6: genomic null\nempirical P = %.4f"%emp,fontsize=10)
o=op.sort_index()
ax[1].bar(range(len(o)),o["log2FC"],color=["#c1442e" if i=="bll6422" else "#6f9ac8" for i in o.index])
ax[1].set_xticks(range(len(o))); ax[1].set_xticklabels(o.index,rotation=45,ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax[1].axhline(0,color="k",lw=.6); ax[1].set_ylabel("log2 fold change (P6 / DMSO)")
ax[1].set_title("fde-like operon response to pterocarpan P6",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
res.loc[OP].to_csv("/agent/jobs/be6dde12-f424-4543-aa88-9103cb899c33/provenance/GSE26380_operon.csv")
